title: Live Windows Tauri UI Automation keyboard and accessible name audit
summary: P02 native CI now probes the actual Windows WebView2 accessibility provider for named preference controls, accessible command dialog/input, keyboard focus and Escape recovery. Evidence is scoped and source-SHA-bound; not a full screen-reader, option or release certification. Initial live Windows UIA runs revealed non-focusable selector representations and search-focus issues; the latest hardened code encountered a separate bounded native-boot timeout before its UIA probe. Native acceptance unverified.
migration_notes: CI-only native UI Automation, no user storage migration.
